name: ES-CL Overlap Session Correlation
description: Rolling 60-bar correlation between ES and CL 5-min returns during the US/EU overlap session (8:00-11:30 AM ET). Tracks intraday co-movement between equities and crude oil during the most liquid cross-asset window. Includes correlation time series, event markers for decorrelation episodes (correlation crossing below zero), and session-level summary statistics.
source:
# ES-CL Rolling Correlation: US/EU Overlap Session (8:00-11:30 AM ET)
# 60-bar rolling correlation on 5-min returns
# Primary asset: ES futures | Reference: CL futures

# --- Data ---
ts = index()()

# ES: primary asset
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

# CL: reference futures
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Session Window: US/EU Overlap 8:00-11:30 AM ET ---
overlap = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)

# --- Returns (1-bar = 5-min returns) ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es_cont.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl_cont.c))

# --- Rolling Correlation (60-bar window) ---
corr_raw = rolling_corr(window=60)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# Isolate correlation to overlap session only
corr_session = where(overlap.active, corr_raw)

# End-of-session snapshot for stats (sparse — avoids S48 ffill distortion)
corr_at_close = where(overlap.closed, corr_raw)

# --- Event Markers: Decorrelation Episodes (corr drops below zero during session) ---
corr_prev = corr_session >> 1
is_decorrelation = is_valid(corr_session) and is_valid(corr_prev) and corr_prev >= 0 and corr_session < 0

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='ES-CL Decorrelation',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(corr_session, es_cont.c, cl_cont.c, is_decorrelation)

# --- Output 1: Rolling Correlation Time Series ---
# ffill_day for rendering continuity within session, NaN between sessions
corr_render = ffill_day(corr_session)

xy_lines(
    title='ES-CL Correlation During US/EU Overlap (8-11:30 AM ET)',
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Bar Rolling Corr', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Moderate (+0.5)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=0.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.05, label='Negative'),
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=1.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Positive')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts.value, y_values=corr_render)

# --- Output 2: Session-Level Summary Stats ---
# Sparse corr_at_close (not ffill) for correct statistics per S48
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Session-Close Correlation Stats',
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Central Tendency', 'Range', 'Sessions'],
        col_headers=['Median', 'Std Dev'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close)
